# xaft

> xaft — Rust-native coding agent runtime: plans, executes, verifies, and delivers code changes with
> transactional safety, real-time observability, and multi-agent orchestration.

## Important symbols

- TUI: `crates/xaft-tui` — triggers (`/`, `@`, `$`, `#`), paste placeholder,
  tool-group collapse, resume-tail replay, mode cycle Safe → Plan → Yolo,
  telemetry, approvals.
- Runtime: `crates/xaft-runtime` — event loop, providers, orchestration,
  session store, compactor.
- Tools: `crates/xaft-tools` — fs/git/shell tools + dynamic factory.
- Config: `crates/xaft-config` — TOML load/merge, env overrides, hot reload.
- Modes: Safe (read-only sandbox), Plan (read-only plan), Yolo/Auto (full).
  Aliases: yolo→auto, ask/guard→safe, review→plan; debug rejected.
